title: Retail Sales Performance Analysis
problem_statement: A retail leadership team needs a consistent view of sales concentration, cancellations, product mix, and market performance before setting inventory and commercial priorities.
questions: Which categories and markets drive net sales?
hypotheses: Seasonal merchandise has greater sales volatility.
Higher-priced lines have different cancellation rates.
recommendations: Investigate the highest-impact category's availability and cancellation drivers.
Create a monthly exception review for categories with both high impact and above-average cancellations.
